ns2:course.label: Financial Economics
ns2:course.description: Theory and logic of microeconomics, taught with applications to financial markets. First half of course covers the way in which efficient markets work to allocate resources; second half covers the way in which markets fail. Also includes selected topics in macroeconomics. Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same or separate terms to a maximum of 4 hours if topic varies.
